_A_THEMING_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: Every component describes its tokens at the end of its SCSS file inside :where(…). They have no specificity, so a simple class selector in your CSS overrides them.
_A_THEMING_DARK_DESCRIPTION_: Set data-a-theme on <html> or on any element. Only the tones and the gray scale change, all colors are recalculated. auto follows the operating system setting (prefers-color-scheme).
_A_THEMING_DENSITY_DESCRIPTION_: data-a-density scales control heights and paddings with --a_density (compact = 0.75, comfortable = 1.25). Font sizes stay the same.
_A_THEMING_FOCUS_DESCRIPTION_: All components show a two-colored focus ring for keyboard focus (:focus-visible): an inner gap and an outer ring. Widths and colors can be overridden globally or on any element. In forced colors mode (Windows high contrast) a system outline is shown instead.
_A_THEMING_GENERATOR_DESCRIPTION_: Choose colors, radius, focus ring, theme and density. The preview updates immediately and the generated CSS can be copied into your project. The contrast column shows the ratio of the text color (white or black) on the chosen color; WCAG AA requires at least 4.5:1.
_A_THEMING_GENERATOR_PREVIEW_ALERT_: This is an alert. All colors follow the base tokens.
_A_THEMING_INTRO_:
All styles of aloha-vue are configured with CSS custom properties (tokens). They change at runtime, without rebuilding SCSS.

  1. Base tokens – the few values a project usually changes: colors as hue / saturation / lightness, gray tint, --a_radius, focus ring widths, --a_density.
  2. Derived tokens – calculated from the base tokens: hover, active, subtle and text variants of each color, gray scale, surfaces, all radii, spacing, focus ring. You never have to define them, but you can override each one.
  3. Component tokens – --a_btn_*, --a_table_*, … They reference the derived tokens and allow fine tuning of one component.
_A_THEMING_LAYERS_DESCRIPTION_: All styles of aloha-vue are in cascade layers. CSS of your application that is not in a layer always wins, independent of specificity.
_A_THEMING_QUICK_START_DESCRIPTION_: Define the base tokens in your own CSS. Theme colors: primary, secondary, tertiary, success, info, warning, danger. Each color has --a_<color>_h, _s and _l.
_A_THEMING_SCOPED_DESCRIPTION_: Derived tokens are calculated on :root, on elements with the class a_theme and on elements with data-a-theme or data-a-density. To re-theme only a part of the page, put the base tokens on such an element.
_A_THEMING_SCOPED_HEADER_: Theme for a part of the page
_A_THEMING_TOKENS_DESCRIPTION_: The current values are read from the page. Derived color tokens exist for every theme color (primary, secondary, tertiary, success, info, warning, danger, light, dark); the table shows primary as an example.
